drills.title: SALT Tagger (with Expectant)
drills.description: SALT adds the hardest call in EMS: EXPECTANT. Read resources carefully — the same injury can be red or gray depending on what's available.

items.prompt: Walked to you; abrasions and a sprained wrist.
items.why: All YES with minor injuries = MINIMAL.

items.prompt: Adult, still, apneic after airway opened.
items.why: Not breathing after airway opening = DEAD.

items.prompt: Child, apneic → airway opened → 2 rescue breaths → now breathing, unresponsive, pulse present.
Open femur fracture, talking, bleeding controlled with pressure dressing.
items.why: All YES, injury not minor = DELAYED.

items.prompt: Arterial thigh bleed — you apply a tourniquet; bleeding stops. Alert, radial present, breathing easily.
items.why: After the LSI, all four are YES and injury is significant = DELAYED. Note TQ + time.

items.prompt: Blast victim, severe respiratory distress, alert.
items.why: Respiratory distress = a NO → IMMEDIATE if survivable.

items.prompt: ~90% full-thickness burns, unresponsive, weak pulse. 50 casualties, 3 ambulances.
items.why: Any NO + survival unlikely with CURRENT resources = EXPECTANT. Comfort care; re-triage later.

items.prompt: Open skull fracture with exposed brain, agonal breathing. Mass-casualty, scarce resources.
Abdominal stab wound, alert, no radial pulse, breathing OK. Resources adequate.
Child, apneic after airway opening and 2 rescue breaths.
Small lacerations; waved when asked; sitting because she's shaken.
items.why: All YES with minor injuries = MINIMAL (re-triage later).

items.prompt: Confused elderly man after the crash, won't follow commands, pulse present, no distress.
Same 90% burns patient as before — 2 hours later, 20 ambulances and burn center beds are available.
items.why: Re-triage when resources change: Expectant can become IMMEDIATE.

items.prompt: Nerve-agent exposure: pinpoint pupils, drooling, wheezing. You give an auto-injector; now breathing easier, obeys, pulse present, no distress.
items.why: After the LSI (auto-injector) all four YES; significant exposure, not minor → DELAYED. Re-triage often.
